text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The main event of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
The crowd was buzzing with excitement as the two who had faced each other in the Takarazuka Kinen gathered once more.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy! You're the strongest!
Show us that winning run of yours once again!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep's victory was no fluke...!
She's sure to show us another thrilling showdown...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. The "Hero" Zenno Rob Roy,
and the "Witch" Sweep Tosho...
It sounds just like a battle from a fairy tale.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with that? It's a fairy tale.
That's precisely why it's so thrilling—

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...I ended up coming to watch after all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (...*sneaking around*)

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha.
She's been following behind me the whole time.
I wonder if she's still worried about what happened back then.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...You don't need to worry about it.
I'm giving up entirely of my own accord.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Watching this race will be my last.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO! Rob Roy!!
Do your best, Sweeeep!"

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: The cheers for Sweep are absolutely electric.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Magic, huh. Sweep-san has never changed
since back then.
No, actually, she just keeps getting more and more amazing."

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: If only I could see common sense as something boring, too...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Sneak, sneak...)

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Kawakami-san, why don't you watch with us?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Eh, u-um, well...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Did you notice?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Because you're way too terrible at hiding your presence. You've been watching me non-stop ever since I left the dorms."

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kawakami-san,
how do you want this race to turn out?

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Is there anyone you're rooting for,
or something specific you're hoping will happen?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Um, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm wishing for someone to cast a spell on me.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Then you're just like me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...So many people are here
to watch over this Tenno Sho (Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right. ———

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(...! Kawakami's here!
And so is she!! ...They really came.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ? Sweep-san?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Rob Roy, I can't afford to run a pointless race today. I've got to blow away all these boring thoughts with magic, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Come at me with everything you've got. So that I can run with everything I've got, too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Fufu... When it comes to competing against you, there is no other choice.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Rousing my entire being—
I shall... strike you down.
